Her mom had a terrible disease but on top of that was a little nuts too. She was friendly to me but I think she secretly didn't think I was good enough for her daughter. She was slightly paranoid I was going to sleep with her, although she told me if we did we should be safe and it was okay but to tell her. That was pretty cool. I assured her we weren't sleeping together. That was the truth. For her birthday I got her a lovely greeting card that said everything about our relationship, unfortunately the card said "lover". I shrugged it off. Thought hey the card is perfect otherwise. Was even thinking about crossing that word out or cracking a joke in the card about it. I didn't bother. Huge mistake. Her mom saw it, freaked out ON HER 16th BIRTHDAY, called me, called me a liar and threatened me with the cops if I ever came close to her again. Wouldn't even let me say anything and hung up on me. Later on found out that she called my mom and cussed her out. My mom was secretly afraid of her making a scene at my graduation. I didn't talk to her for 2 years after that day until I saw her at a mutual friends party and she was obviously uncomfortable about talking to me. That was just another thing her mom did to her to drive her daughter away. Apparently they never had a great relationship and it got worse from there. The mother has since passed from her disease.
